## About
Barsh Auto Service is a full-service repair and preventive maintenance shop in South Conroe, independently owned and operated. We work on domestic and imported vehicles, and we use parts that meet or exceed the manufacturer's standards.
If your car needs scheduled maintenance, you don't have to take it back to the dealership. We can service it here and your manufacturer's warranty stays intact.
Something feel, sound or smell off? A shimmy in the steering wheel, a clunk when turning, a new light on the dash, a burning smell. Stop by or give us a call and one of our technicians will help you figure out what's going on before it turns into something bigger. We serve folks from Conroe, Montgomery, Willis, Woodlands and Spring.

## Services
- Brake repairs: Brake inspections, pad replacement, caliper repair, rotor replacement and brake fluid service for domestic and import vehicles.
- Scheduled maintenance: Routine maintenance for your personal or company auto, pickup or truck, without the dealership trip.
- Towing and roadside assistance: Barsh Towing and Roadside Assistance is available 24/7 if your vehicle can't make it to the shop.

## FAQ
Q: Will servicing my car here affect my manufacturer's warranty?
A: No. Wherever your vehicle was built, we can service it and still maintain the manufacturer's warranty.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: We're qualified to repair and service domestic and imported vehicles, from personal cars to company pickups and trucks.

Q: How do I make an appointment?
A: You can book online or call the shop at the number listed on this page.
